disease_state.evidence: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) continues to have a high mortality.

material_type.evidence: Eligible subjects consisted of individuals with ARDS as defined by American-European Consensus Conference (AECC) criteria treated at the University of Minnesota Medical Center between May 2009 and September 2012.

sample_source.evidence: This study included 36 subjects who underwent a clinically indicated bronchoscopy within seven days of their ARDS diagnosis and for whom excess BALF was available.

tissue.evidence: inferred: This study included 36 subjects who underwent a clinically indicated bronchoscopy within seven days of their ARDS diagnosis and for whom excess BALF was available.
